title: cyclophorus penangianus
intro: Cyclophorus penangianus, commonly known as the Penang Cyclophorus or Penang Cyclops, is a species of snail-eating land snail that belongs to the family Cyclophoridae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may aid in reducing pain and improving overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of Cyclophorus penangianus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antimicrobial and cytotoxic activities. Additionally, its extracts have been studied for their potential in treating various health conditions, including cancer and cardiovascular diseases.
